source.title: Competitor flipped over FMC scramble before attempt began
source.content: A competitor flipped over the scramble sheet for an FMC attempt before the attempt started. The delegates assure that they had made it clear not to flip over the paper prior to the attempt. Since the competitor saw the scramble due to their own flaw, it was decided to rule this attempt as a DNF.

translation.title: 选手在最少步开始前翻开打乱纸
translation.content: 一名选手在最少步尝试开始前翻开了打乱纸。代表确认已明确告知不得提前翻开。由于选手因自身过错看到了打乱，决定将该次尝试判为 DNF。
